title: Alien
description: Hunt an alien through the air vents of your spaceship before it finds you. My 1979 re-theme of Gregory Yob's Hunt the Wumpus.
versionOrder: Inferred development sequence, not established dates. Both versions are on tape22b: v01 (saves 6-7) precedes v02 (saves 8-9) in save order, and v02 contains v01's game with additions. Tape numbers alone do not establish chronology.

versions.label: Early · Alien re-theme
versions.note: Hunt the Wumpus re-themed: air vents, vacuum chambers, computer failure and poison gas. Drops Yob's crooked-arrow check.
